Rare is a pretty sweet spot in my opinion.  You will be in the 76-89% range of people who get to pick, and if you are prepared you will likely be in the top 85 percentile.  Those are going to be some great spots if you intend to play and participate in active B2E/P2E/ect...

It also allows you to snipe very solid spots next to active areas that will be developed by large land-holding entities.  Having a mythic is great if you have your own economy spoken for, but being able to nestle in next to a strong guild after they establish their central bases will have a lot of value.  Most of this will happen in that "rare" period of the land rush.
Owners of rarer plots get to choose the location of the plot before owners of less rare land.
Uncommon will also have a lot of opportunities here, and if you are unsure of who the big winners will be 2 of these will give you more expsoure.

1) Rockup 5 min before your mint window (nft.cornucopias.io/nft-sale)

4) Make sure you have more than 10ADA available to cover TX (Gas) fees

 15 Second Raffle Window be prepaired 
1st successful mint and you are out (one mint per person)
Tier 1: 1000  (OG or NFT2Tree holder)
Tier 2: 1000  (Vehicle or Land holder)
Tier 3: 520   (Public)
NFS   : 80    (team and promotions)
If you are not successful in tier one and you qualify for tier 2 you can mint in that and tier 3 is for everyone (small supply)

T2: 13:40 (pre-registration 13:35 UTC)

Minting best practice  
1) Rockup 5 min before your mint window (nft.cornucopias.io/nft-sale)
2) Make sure you have your 5ADA collateral set in your wallet
3) Make sure you wallet is set to mainnet, not testnet
4) Make sure you have more than 10ADA available to cover TX (Gas) fees

 15 Second Raffle Window be prepaired 
1st successful mint and you are out (one mint per person)
Tier 1: 1000  (OG or NFT2Tree holder)
Tier 2: 1000  (Vehicle or Land holder)
Tier 3: 520   (Public)
NFS   : 80    (team and promotions)
If you are not successful in tier one and you qualify for tier 2 you can mint in that and tier 3 is for everyone (small supply)

T1: 13:00 UTC (pre-registration 12:55 UTC)
T2: 13:40 (pre-registration 13:35 UTC)
T3: 14:20 (pre-registration 14:15 UTC)

You can only mint with NAMI, Eternl, and Gero (supported wallets)

Sending ADA to the Cornucopias address will just lose your ADA, only mint using the site

Don't try and mint from mobile, it will not work

Hello guys

Sale Pre-Registration
Our Marketplace now has a new feature that allows for sale registration. For those of you that participated in our land sale, you may have noticed a bottleneck in performance on the queue entry (indicated by spinning circle for some). This new feature is designed to mitigate the load on our server which will eliminate the bottleneck. We are essentially removing a massive number of users flooding a single point of entry all at once. In addition, this registration process will make it harder for bots to participate. Here is how it will work… 
 
Prior to the sale, we will have a registration period in which a “register now” button will appear. This button will become available randomly for users at different times on the sale page. The minimum time eligible users will have to register is 5 minutes before the tier opens. 
 
When the register button goes live on your screen, you can begin the registration process. On the first step you will be presented with all the essential information about the current NFT sale (price, transaction fee, recommended amount of ADA, etc). 
 
After confirming this information, you will proceed to step 2 of the registration process by clicking “register” at the bottom right corner of the popup. On step two of the registration, you will be signing the transaction with whichever wallet you choose to mint with. After signing the transaction, you will be prompted to complete a captcha. After successfully completing the captcha you will see a “registration successful” pop up. At this point, all you need to do is wait for the sale to go live and you will be able to click “Enter Queue”, which will be a single click action, so no more frantically clicking through multiple steps and pasting in wallet passwords.

I recently got an M2 mac - the 3000 tx wallet opens as fast maybe faster than an empty wallet did on my old laptop.  The wallet speed mattered both for when you could click the order button, and then how long it took the payment prompt window to come up.
